senses.sense_definition: A person who asks many questions, often in a way that feels intense or demanding.

examples.text: The detective acted like an <w>inquisitor</w> while questioning the suspect about his whereabouts.
She felt like an <w>inquisitor</w> because she kept asking her brother about his secret plans.

senses.sense_definition: A historical official of the Catholic Church responsible for investigating and punishing heresy.

examples.text: The <w>inquisitor</w> presided over the trial to determine if the accused held forbidden beliefs.
Historical records describe how the <w>inquisitor</w> sought to suppress dissent within the church.

traits.comment: Refers to a specific historical role.
